verdict.rationale: Kimi has a documented public API. The Kimi Code API is OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, and members create API keys in the Kimi Code Console. The Kimi API Platform publishes an unauthenticated OpenAPI 3.1 spec, an Admin API spec, a Try-it playground, /v1 versioning and a deprecation table. However, a probe found the consumer assistant app itself has no public API: the platform API is a separate pay-as-you-go product, so assistant features such as agent mode, deep research and scheduled tasks are not shown to be API-drivable. Missing for 10: API coverage of the assistant app's own features, an API changelog and deprecation policy, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
